answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 28181 Country: India Title: My friend's wife quarreled with his parents, so he became impatient and he said talaq talaq talaq to his wife.but he doesn't know that his wife would become haram for him.can they lead their married life again or not. Question: my friend's wife quarreled with his parents, so he became impatient and he said talaq talaq talaq to his wife.but he doesn't know that his wife would become haram for him.can they lead their married life again or not. Answer ID: 28181 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 86/84/B=1432) In the question mentioned above, all three talaqs took place and she was divorced with talaq mughallazah (irrevocable talaqs) and now he cannot live as husband with her without a valid halalah. According to shariah, ignorance is not considered an excuse, talaq takes places in all cases whether he knows the ruling or not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
